customer: Owner of a small service company moving beyond spreadsheets
problem: Monthly accounts need reconciliation and understandable reports before decisions.
offer: Remote monthly bookkeeping and tax-ready reporting.
serviceScope: Categorization, account reconciliation, monthly P&L and balance sheet, and a review call. No tax filing, audit, or legal advice.

proof.statement: The source is a synthetic operator brief. There is no observed client outcome, testimonial, credential, or project image.

conversion: Email a fit-call request; the team replies within two business days to arrange a 20-minute conversation. Sending does not book a time.

facts.claim: Monthly bookkeeping and tax-ready reporting for small service companies.

No tax filing, audits, or legal advice.
